target: 643 Meta Suspectus

source: 643 Target Suspect
target: 643 Meta Suspectus

source: Camus couldn’t comprehend why Louis Berry had abruptly changed the topic and neglected to charge for the pertinent information.
target: Camus non poterat intellegere cur Louis Berry subitam dissertionis mutationem fecisset atque pretium pro rebus pertinentibus exigere neglexerit.

source: Recollecting, he mentioned, “Yes, there’s a Magician.
target: Meminens, dixit: “Ita, Magus est.

source: He was initially an officer of the Admiral Guard but later got transferred to the patrol team.”
target: Primum fuit officarius custodiae admiralis, sed postea ad manipulum vigilum transmissus est.

source: Later… Lumian frowned slightly.
target: Postea… Lumian leviter vultum contraxit.

source: “When did he transfer to the patrol team?”
target: “Quando ad manipulum vigilum transmissus est?”

source: “Why do you ask? Last year,” replied Camus.
target: “Cur rogas? Anno praeterito,” respondit Camus.

source: He had no clue about Louis Berry’s inquiry, making it unclear what information was vital.
target: Nullam scientiam habebat de quaestione Louis Berry, unde incertum erat quae notitia esset necessaria.

source: Last year… It doesn’t seem to be Hisoka, judging by appearances… Although possibilities can’t be completely ruled out.
target: Anno praeterito… Ex aspectu videtur non esse Hisoka; quamquam omnes facultates omnino excludi non possunt.

source: Serving as an officer in Admiral Querarill’s guard provides opportunities for gathering intel.
target: Officium gerens sub custodia Admiralis Querarill opportunitates notitiarum colligendarum praebet.

source: Perhaps he didn’t purchase Fermo coffee from this Import Export Shop.
target: Fortasse non empsit Fermo coffee ex hac Taberna Importationis et Exportationis.

source: It could be one of the other two cafes…
target: Fieri potest ut sit unus ex reliquorum duorum caféinorum…

source: Even so, there’s a logical reason for buying it here.
target: At tamen, ratio logica invenitur qua hic emandum sit.

source: Yes, to relish watching the incompetence and frustration of the patrol team…
target: Ita, ut fruatur spectando ineptiam atque frustrationem manipuli vigilum…

source: Lumian temporarily placed the Magician on his suspect list.
target: Lumian magum temporarie in indice suspectorum consignavit.

source: He didn’t dismiss the possibility that the other party was Hisoka just because they were a Sequence 7.
target: Non neglexit possibilitatem alterius esse Hisoka, solum quia ille erat Series VII.

source: This was because the level of a boon might not be the same as the level brought about by potions.
target: Nam gradus doni non necessario idem esse potest ac gradus, quos potiones efficiunt.

source: Furthermore, Lumian had vaguely perceived changes beneath Matani’s surface from the Magician’s departure from Admiral Querarill’s guard to joining the patrol team.
target: Praeterea, Lumian leviter perceptit mutationes sub superficie Matani, ab exitu Magi e custodia Admiralis Querarill ad ingressum in manipulum vigilum.

source: Beyonders of the Seer pathway either originated from the Church of The Fool or were associated with Intis’s Bureau 8 or secret organizations supporting Bureau 8, like the Secret Order.
target: Beyonderes viae Videntis vel ex Ecclesia Stulti orti sunt, vel coniuncti erant cum Officina VIII Intis aut cum societatibus occultis quae Officinae VIII favent, ut Ordo Secretus.

source: While there were wild Beyonders, very few evolved into Magicians.
target: Dum beyonderes feroces exstiterunt, pauci tamen in magos evoluti sunt.

source: Coupled with Matani’s history as an Intis colony, Lumian reasonably deduced that the Magician had close ties to the Intis Republic, a fact well-known to Admiral Querarill.
target: Coniuncta cum historia Matani ut colonia Intis, Lumian rite concludit magum nexūs arctos habuisse cum Republica Intis, rem quae Admirali Querarill bene nota erat.

source: He retained the Magician in the guards to maintain a specific connection with Intis and handle the new Feynapotter Kingdom.
target: Magum in custodia retinuit ad nexum certum cum Intis conservandum atque regendum novum Regnum Feynapotter.

source: By achieving a balance of power, he could better sustain his rule.
target: Per certam potentiae aequalitatem, suam dominationem melius servare poterat.

source: The Magician’s departure from the Admiral Guard last year might indicate that Admiral Querarill had truly gauged the Feynapotter Kingdom’s stance after years of collaboration and had sided with them.
target: Exitus Magi e custodia Admiralis anno praeterito fortasse significat Admiralem Querarill statum Regni Feynapotter post annos cooperationis recte aestimavisse et cum eis consenserit.

source: Lumian’s speculation didn’t eliminate the suspicion that the Magician might be Hisoka.
target: Cogitatio Lumiani suspicionem non sublata est quod magus fortasse esset Hisoka.

source: Loki, from Intis and a Secret Order member, held a mid-management position in Bureau 8.
target: Loki, ex Intis et membrum Ordinis Secreti, positionem mediam in Officina VIII gerebat.

source: It was entirely possible for him to use the proper channels to involve Hisoka in Bureau 8’s overseas section and recruit him into the Secret Order.
target: Plane erat ei possibile uti canalibus idoneis, ut Hisoka in sectionem peregrinam Officinae VIII involveretur atque in Ordine Secreto susciperetur.

source: After contemplating for a moment, Lumian inquired, “Does that Magician have a fondness for Fermo coffee?”
target: Post paulum meditatus, Lumian quaesivit: “Magusne ille Fermo coffee delectat?”

source: He didn’t directly ask about the other party’s name and characteristics.
target: Non directe quaesivit de nomine ac attributis alterius partis.

source: Camus shook his head.
target: Camus caput quassavit.

source: “He doesn’t appreciate coffee. His preference leans towards sweet drinks like Gwadar.”
target: “Non amat coffeum. Praefert potiones dulces ut Gwadar.”

source: Gwadar, a well-loved local beverage in West Balam, was crafted from locally grown berries and contained a certain amount of caffeine.
target: Gwadar, potio localis in Occidente Balam bene amata, ex bacis localiter crescentibus confecta erat et aliquam quantitatem caffeinae continebat.

source: It had the same impact as coffee in enhancing mental strength and combating fatigue.
target: Eandem vim habebat ac coffeum, quod robur mentis augeret et lassitudinem expugnaret.

source: However, its hue was orange-yellow, with a hint of sweetness amidst the sourness.
target: Attamen, eius color erat aurantiaco-fulvus, cum levissima dulcedine inter aciditatem.

source: It served both to alleviate the sweltering heat and quench thirst.
target: Utrumque ad levandam caliditatem ferventem atque ad sitim sedandam serviebat.

source: Prefers sweetness… Lumian felt a sense of disappointment.
target: Dulcedinem praeferens… Lumian parum delusionis sensit.

source: Four years ago, Hisoka had no inkling that he would confront a monster like Ludwig in the future.
target: Quattuor annos abhinc, Hisoka nescius erat se monstrum sicut Ludwig futurum oppugnaturum.

source: It was unlikely for him to deliberately splash some unsweetened Fermo coffee on the table with the chocolate.
target: Parum verisimile fuit ei ut deliberate Fermo coffee, sine dulcedine, super mensam cum chocolata aspergeret.

source: Lumian cautiously believed now that Hisoka truly enjoyed bitter coffee.
target: Lumian nunc caute credidit quod Hisoka vere amaro coffeum delectaretur.

source: In that case, the Magician, with a sweet tooth, probably wasn’t Hisoka.
target: In hoc casu, magus, qui dulcedinem praeferret, verisimiliter non erat Hisoka.

source: Unless Hisoka meticulously maintained the traits of each identity, consistently playing the role of a Magician who relished drinking Gwadar on a daily basis.
target: Nisi Hisoka diligenter singula identitatis signa serviret atque constanter partes Magi ageret, qui cotidie Gwadar bibere delectaretur.

source: He wasn’t an Actor who needed to meticulously perform every aspect of his daily life!
target: Non erat actor, qui cuncta vitae suae puncta diligenter perficeret!

source: Moreover, he had no reason to digest Faceless!
target: Praeterea, nullam habebat rationem ut “Faceless” digereretur!

source: As he contemplated, Lumian’s heart skipped a beat.
target: Dum meditabat, cor Lumiani paulum saltavit.

source: Actor…
target: Actor…

source: If Hisoka is genuinely a Beyonder of the Devil pathway, apart from his belief in the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings due to transmigration, he might also be influenced by the Mother Tree of Desire in his daily life.
target: Si Hisoka vere fuerit Beyonder viae Diaboli, praeter fidem suam in Divinam Dignitatem Caeli et Terrae ad Benedictiones ex transmigratione, fortasse etiam a Mater Arbore Desiderii in vita sua quotidiana influeretur.

source: Could it be that the boon of the Hisoka pathway doesn’t come from one of the Celestial Worthy’s Seer, Apprentice, or Marauder, but rather from the Mother Tree of Desire?
target: Num potest fieri ut donum viae Hisoka non ex uno ex Videntibus, discipulis aut marauderis Divini Digni proveniat, sed potius ex Mater Arbore Desiderii?

source: The current Celestial Worthy desires the invasion of evil gods into the world within the barrier.
target: Divinus Dignus Caelestis praesentis desiderat invasionem deorum malorum in orbem intra limites.

source: It’s not implausible for Him to collaborate with the Mother Tree of Desire and tacitly permit Hisoka to exploit the Mother Tree of Desire…
target: Non est incredibile ei cum Mater Arbore Desiderii cooperari et tacite Hisokae licentiam dare ut eam expleat…

source: With a fresh train of thought, Lumian observed the now-silent Camus and took a sip of Intis coffee, offering a smile as he changed the subject.
target: Nova cogitatione renovata, Lumian, Camum iam silentem observans, sorbillum coffeum Intis sumpsit et subridente rem mutavit.

source: “Any Beyonders from the Prisoner pathway in the patrol team?”
target: “Numquid sunt beyonderes ex via Prisoneris in manipulo vigilum?”

source: He had long suspected that the Mother Tree of Desire was an evil deity at the pinnacle of the Criminal, Prisoner, and Scrooge pathways.
target: Iam diu suspicabatur Mater Arbor Desiderii deum malum esse in culmine viae Criminalis, Prisoneris, et Scrooge.

source: The corresponding boons likely originated from one of them or were intertwined.
target: Beneficia attinentia probabiliter ex uno ex illis orta erant aut inter se intertexta erant.

source: Lumian refrained from asking about the existence of the Scrooge pathway because it was even more suspicious than the Criminal pathway, also known as the Devil pathway.
target: Lumian ab interrogatione de existentia viae Scrooge abstinuit, quia illa magis suspecta videbatur quam via Criminalis, quae etiam via Diaboli notissima est.

source: It didn’t belong to the twenty-two paths of the divine.
target: Non pertinebat ad viginti duos semitas divinas.

source: It was akin to a thief being apprehended by the police and asking in confusion, “I clearly disguised myself and left no traces. How did you quickly lock onto me,” only to receive the answer, “This isn’t Trier. No ordinary person would disguise themselves as a turkey and hide in a secluded alley.”
target: Hoc erat simile latro comprehenso a vigilibus, qui in confusione quaerebat: “Manifestum est me convertisse et nullas vestigia reliquisse; quomodo me celeriter deprehendistis?” ad quam responsum venit: “Hoc non est Trier; nullus homo vulgaris se in forma meleagridis fingit atque in obscuro angulo absconditur.”

source: “Do you think there’s a spy from the Rose School of Thought in the patrol team?”
target: “Putasne speculatorem ex Schola Rosi Sententiarum in manipulo vigilum esse?”

source: Camus believed Louis Berry was casually raising the issue of the Rose School of Thought’s interest in Port Pylos.
target: Camus credidit Ludovicum Berry casualiter quaestionem de studio Scholae Rosi in Port Pylos proponere.

source: “No, definitely not. He adheres to temperance and doesn’t indulge at all.”
target: “Non, certe non. Moderationi se adhaeret atque omnino non indulgeat.”

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridit.

source: “In other words, there really is a Beyonder from the Prisoner pathway?”
target: “Aliter dicendo, num vere sit Beyonder ex via Prisoneris?”

source: “Yes, a Sequence 6 Zombie…” Camus confirmed.
target: “Ita, Sequencia VI Zombie…” confirmavit Camus.

source: Lumian interjected suddenly, “Don’t disclose who he is, what he looks like, or his characteristics. Answer a few questions first.”
target: Lumian subito interpellans dixit: “Noli revelare quis sit, qualis videatur, aut eius attributa; primo pauca quaesita responde.”

source: “What questions?” Camus, feeling a bit disoriented from the rapidly changing topics, planned to decide when to ask for benefits later.
target: “Quae quaestiones?” inquit Camus, paulo perturbatus a celeriter mutantibus argumentis, et statuere cogitabat quando de beneficiis quaerendum esset.

source: Lumian held a porcelain cup filled with Intis coffee and casually said, “When did he join the patrol team?”
target: Lumian poculum ex porcelaneo plenum coffeum Intis tenens, leve dixit: “Quando ad manipulum vigilum transmissus est?”

source: “Half a year after me,” Camus recalled.
target: “Dimidio anno post me,” respondit Camus.

source: You arrived in Matani over five years ago and joined the patrol team shortly after.
target: Matani quinque annos abhinc advenisti et mox ad manipulum vigilum accessisti.

source: Half a year later means that the Prisoner was already on the patrol team when the serial murder case occurred four years ago…
target: Dimidio anno post me significat Prisoner iam in manipulo vigilum esse, cum casus serialis homicidii quattuor annos abhinc evenisset…

source: Lumian’s spirits lifted as he pondered for a moment.
target: Animus Lumiani levatus est, dum paulum meditabat.

source: “Did he face a catastrophe in the past and nearly died?”
target: “Obiitne in praeterito calamitate et paene mortuus est?”

source: “No.” Camus shook his head. “At least, I don’t know.”
target: “Non.” inquit Camus, caput quassans, “saltem nescio.”

source: Lumian maintained his smile, showing no signs of disappointment, and said, “Does he have a liking for Fermo coffee?”
target: Lumian subridens permanebat, nullis signis delusionis ostentans, et dixit: “Habetne affectionem pro Fermo coffee?”

source: “Yes, he adores Fermo coffee and is the type who doesn’t add sugar,” replied Camus without much thought.
target: “Ita, Fermo coffee colit et talis est qui saccharum non adicit,” respondit Camus sine multo cogitandi.

source: Then, he remembered Louis Berry’s inquiry about the Magician’s preference for Fermo coffee in the patrol team.
target: Tum memor fuit interrogationis Ludovici Berry de praeferentia Magi ad Fermo coffee in manipulo vigilum.

source: He quickly formed a guess.
target: Celeriter coniecturam fecit.

source: “Is there an issue with the ones enjoying Fermo coffee? Does the culprit of the serial murders four years ago have a taste for Fermo coffee? There are very few places in Port Pylos where you can get Fermo coffee. This is one of them. Even cafes selling Fermo coffee procure the beans from here… Are you suspecting that the murderer from four years ago is part of the patrol team?”
target: “Estne quaestio de illis qui Fermo coffee fruuntur? Gustatne scelestus caedes serialis homicidii quattuor annos abhinc Fermo coffee? Pauca sunt loca in Port Pylos, ubi Fermo coffee adipisci potest. Hoc est unum ex iis. Etiam cauponae quae Fermo coffee vendunt, ex hac regione granum colligunt… Num suspicis homicidem ex quattuor annos abhinc pars esse manipuli vigilum?”

source: Impressive. You reacted swiftly and identified the core issue… Lumian inwardly praised Camus.
target: Impressivum. Celeriter egisti et rem principalem agnovisti… Lumian Camum intus laudavit.

source: Simultaneously, a surge of joy filled his heart.
target: Simul, exsultatio gaudii cor eius replevit.

source: In Matani, Fermo coffee was a rare commodity, and those who preferred it without sugar were even rarer.
target: In Matani, Fermo coffee rara merces erat, et qui id sine saccharo praeferebant, etiam rari erant.

source: Moreover, this individual was on the patrol team and seemingly from the Prisoner pathway!
target: Praeterea, hic individuum in manipulo vigilum aderat et videbatur ex via Prisoneris provenire!

source: With so many conditions aligning, Lumian felt like he had caught Hisoka by the tail!
target: Cum tot res congruabant, Lumian sensit se Hisoka cauda cepisse!

source: To avoid triggering any sense of malice and danger, Lumian refrained from asking about the patrol team member’s name, appearance, identity, or characteristics.
target: Ne ullam malitiae atque periculi impressionem excitaret, Lumian abstinuit de nomine, specie, identitate aut attributis membrorum manipuli vigilum rogare.

source: Feigning ignorance about the enemy, Lumian casually asked, “Is he from around here?”
target: Fingens ignorance hostis, Lumian leviter rogavit: “Estne hic ex hac regione?”

source: Observing Camus’s silence, Lumian added with a smile, “I won’t claim the official bounty.”
target: Observante silentio Camus, Lumian subridente addidit: “Praemium officiale non postulo.”

source: Camus’s expression eased.
target: Vultus Camus relaxatus est.

source: “He’s a local of Port Pylos, born in Tizamo Town, which is part of Port Pylos.”
target: “Ille est indigenus Portus Pylos, natus in oppido Tizamo, quod pars Portus Pylos est.”

source: Though the patrol team wasn’t as stringent in member recruitment as the various Churches and governments, they still gathered basic information and conducted verifications.
target: Quamquam manipulus vigilum non tam rigorose membrorum delectu utebatur quam varia Ecclesiae et regimina, tamen notitiae fundamentales colligebantur et probationes fiebant.

source: Otherwise, Admiral Querarill might have to worry about being assassinated by a patrol team member investigating a Beyonder case one day.
target: Alioquin, Admiralis Querarill fortasse sollicitus futurus erat ne a membro manipuli vigilum, qui causam Beyonder indagaret, occideretur.

source: Tizamo Town… the location of one of Hisoka’s pranks… It fits!
target: Oppidum Tizamo… locus unius Hisokae iocusum… convenit!

source: Lumian controlled his excitement, preventing the corners of his mouth from curling up.
target: Lumian suam ardorem moderatus est, ne anguli oris eius incurvarent.

source: Regrettably, he told Camus,
target: Infeliciter, ille Camum dixit:

source: “Unfortunately, that doesn’t seem to be the target.”
target: “Infeliciter, hoc meta non videtur.”

source: This was to prevent Camus from investigating the target.
target: Hoc factum est ne Camus metae indagationem faceret.

source: This could potentially alert the other party to the corresponding malice!
target: Hoc potuit alteram partem de malitia congruente excitare!

source: “All right.” Camus shrugged.
target: “Bene,” inquit Camus, umeros elevans.

source: Curious, he inquired, “How did you find out that the murderer from the serial killings four years ago liked Fermo coffee?”
target: Curiosus, inquisivit: “Quomodo cognovisti homicydem caedes serialis quattuor annos abhinc Fermo coffee diligere?”

source: “I was already aware of such a person before starting the investigation,” Lumian replied with a meaningful tone.
target: “Iam sciebam talis hominem antequam indagationem iniret,” respondit Lumian tono significativo.

source: He chose not to disclose that the information came from the thin aluminum foil wrapping of the chocolate.
target: Eligebat non declarare hanc informationem ex tenue lamina aluminii, quo chocolatum involutum erat, provenisse.

source: Revealing this might prompt Camus to believe he could uncover more clues and reignite the investigation, potentially drawing Hisoka’s attention.
target: Hoc revelatum Camum compellare posset ut credat se plura indicia deprehendere atque indagationem iterum suscitare, fortasse Hisokae attentionem attrahendo.

source: With this realization, Lumian understood something.
target: Hoc intellexit, Lumian aliquid comprehenderat.

source: I should now be a target for Hisoka, but fishing has its benefits…
target: Nunc mihi esse debet meta Hisokae, sed piscatio utilitates habet…

source: Louis Berry, adorned with a golden straw hat, had bribed members of the patrol team to examine the files of the serial murder case from four years ago.
target: Louis Berry, galea stragulam aurea ornatus, membra manipuli vigilum corruptit ut fasciculos casus serialis homicidii quattuor annos abhinc inspiciendum curaret.

source: Other team members paid little attention, but if the Prisoner was indeed Hisoka, he would have detected Lumian—his adversary’s investigation into the four-year-old serial murder case.
target: Ceteri membri parum attendebant, sed si Prisoner vere Hisoka fuisset, eum – investigationem adversarii sui de casu serialis homicidii quattuor annos abhinc – detegisset.

source: Hisoka refrained from taking action likely because Lumian openly presented himself as Louis Berry, making no effort to hide his identity.
target: Hisoka actu agere abnegavit, verisimiliter quod Lumian se manifeste ut Louis Berry exhibuerat nec ullam operam ad identitatem celandam intulisset.

source: This led to the suspicion that Lumian was fishing, making Hisoka cautious of stepping into a potential trap.
target: Hoc ad suspicionem duxit Lumian piscationem agere, faciens ut Hisoka cautus ficeretur ne in insidiam incidat.

source: There was no sense of malice or danger perceived, as Lumian didn’t possess details about the suspect’s identity.
target: Nullum sensum malitiae aut periculi perceptum fuit, quia Lumian de identitate suspecti notitiam non habebat.

source: Lumian was merely preparing for a potential surprise attack from a Devil or Desire Apostle.
target: Lumian tantum se parabat ad incertam repentinam incursionem ab Diabolo aut Desiderii Apostolo.

source: Before, I fished to catch fish, but now my fishing is a bluff…
target: Prius piscabar ad pisces capiendos, sed nunc piscatio mea simulatio est…

source: Lumian’s thoughts clarified as he looked at Camus and said, “Keep an eye out for anyone at the police headquarters who enjoys Fermo coffee.”
target: Cogitationes Lumiani clarificatae sunt, dum Camum observabat, et dixit: “Cave, et observa, si quis in praesidio vigilum Fermo coffee amans adest.”

source: “All right,” Camus agreed, thinking that Louis Berry had identified the suspect as a member of the patrol team and the police through details he wasn’t aware of.
target: “Bene,” respondit Camus, cogitans Ludovicum Berry suspicatum esse ut membrum manipuli vigilum et policiæ ex notitia, quam ipse ignorerat, agnosceret.

source: For now, the possibility of the patrol team members was tentatively ruled out.
target: Pro tempore, possibilitas membrorum manipuli vigilum caute excludebatur.

source: After finishing the remaining Intis coffee and settling the bill with the corresponding verl d’or, Lumian donned the golden straw hat and maintained his smile.
target: Postquam reliquum coffeum Intis consumpsit et solutionem cum correspondente verl d’or liquvit, Lumian galeam stragulam auream indutus, subridente permanebat.

source: He left the Matani Import and Export Shop and Cania Street, step by step.
target: Matani Importationis et Exportationis Tabernam atque viam Cania, gradatim, reliquit.

source: Passing by Port Pylos’s police headquarters, he deliberately cast a few glances.
target: Transiens praesidium policiæ Portus Pylos, deliberate nonnullas speculatus est.
